copy.headline: 10 minutes of sniffing does more than a 30-minute walk
copy.lede: A snuffle mat shaped like a plate of food. Hide their kibble in it and watch a bored dog switch off — the calm kind of tired.
copy.body_html:
Sniffing is work. It lowers a dog’s heart rate and burns mental energy the way a walk burns physical energy. Scatter a handful of their normal food into the mat before you leave the house and they have a job to do instead of your skirting board.

Dense fleece fingers, non-slip backing, machine-washable. Food-grade, no loose parts.
bullets: Turns 30 seconds of feeding into 15–40 minutes of work
Something to do the moment you leave — not a cure, a job
Food-grade, no small parts to swallow
Rotate with a second theme when they get quick at it
copy.proof: Modelar a prova de PawzNDogz ("As Seen On" + "science that turns chaos into calm"). Sem reviews inventadas no lançamento; usar UGC de "antes/depois" quando existir.

faq.q: Does this help with separation anxiety?
faq.a: It is not a treatment for separation anxiety — talk to a behaviourist for that. What it does is give an under-stimulated dog something absorbing to do, which for a lot of bored dogs is most of the problem.

faq.q: My dog destroys everything — will it survive?
faq.a: The fleece is stitched into a rubber base, not glued. It is for foraging, not chewing; supervise a heavy chewer the first few sessions.
Shake out the crumbs, cold machine wash in a laundry bag, air dry.

pages.title: Shipping & Delivery
pages.body_html: Orders ship from the UK. Standard delivery 3–6 working days. Free over £35, otherwise £3.95. Tracking emailed on dispatch.

pages.title: Returns
pages.body_html: 30-day "your dog ignored it" guarantee: if your dog genuinely won’t engage, send it back for a refund. Unused items returnable within 30 days. Modelled on the satisfaction guarantees used by qualified competitors in this research.

pages.title: Recipes & Fillings
pages.body_html: Snuffle mat: their normal kibble, scattered. Lick mat: wet food, plain yoghurt, mashed banana, xylitol-free peanut butter — freeze for a 20-minute version. Puzzle: small high-value treats. Rotate.

pages.title: Does it help with separation anxiety?
pages.body_html: Honest answer: this is not a treatment for separation anxiety. If your dog panics when left alone, a qualified behaviourist is the right call. What these mats do is give an under-stimulated, bored dog something absorbing to do — and for a lot of dogs, boredom is most of what looks like anxiety. Give the mat 10 minutes before you leave, not as you walk out the door.

pages.title: Why Enrichment
pages.body_html: Sniffing and licking are work. They lower a dog’s heart rate and use mental energy the way a walk uses physical energy. Ten minutes of nose work can settle a dog more than a lap of the park. That’s the whole idea.

production_notes: Cada anúncio: 1 gancho + 1 ângulo + 1 objeção. Rodar 5 no lançamento, cortar 3 piores em 4–5 dias. O advertorial tem o maior teto — priorizar.
Sem transcrição frame a frame dos criativos dos concorrentes nesta rodada — modelar a estrutura observável, não copiar copy.
Nunca usar imagem, logo, naming de tema (PawzNDogz "Buttery Avocado"™) ou alegação proprietária de concorrente.
Linha vermelha de copy: nunca "cures/stops anxiety". Usar "keeps them busy", "mental tiredness", "something to do before you leave".
